chunks: Ya'qub ibn Zayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Shu'ayb, from Abi Kahmas, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Six things reach the believer after his death: a child who seeks forgiveness for him, a mushaf that he leaves behind, a planting that he plants, a well that he digs, a charity that he sets in motion, and a sunnah that is acted upon after him.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنَ: The believer who receives continuing benefit after death
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: A normative practice followed after a person's death
key_terms.سِتَّةٌ: Six enduring matters mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.مُصْحَفٌ: A written copy of the Qur'an left behind
key_terms.وَفَاتِهِ: His death, after which these benefits still reach him
key_terms.يَسْتَغْفِرُ: Seeks forgiveness from Allah for him

ai.seo_question: What deeds continue to benefit a believer after death in this hadith of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that some righteous آثار of a believer continue to benefit him after death. It highlights ongoing benefit through family, transmitted scripture, charitable works, and a sunnah that remains practiced after him.
